statements.status_notes: Vulnerable code is in hostapd RADIUS authentication (AP mode, CONFIG_WIFI_NM_HOSTAPD_AP); Infuse-IoT uses wpa_supplicant in station mode, which is not enabled by Infuse-IoT.
statements.action_statement: Fix will not be backported: not standard Infuse-IoT feature

statements.impact_statement: The timing side channel is only introduced when compiling with LLVM's select-optimize pass. Infuse-IoT (including the TF-M image that uses Mbed TLS 3.6) is built with the GCC based Zephyr SDK toolchain.
The vulnerable code is in hostapd AP-mode IEEE 802.11be Multi-Link Operation association processing (src/ap/ieee802_11_eht.c, CONFIG_IEEE80211BE), which the Zephyr hostap integration does not build.
